body_template:
Common Pitfalls in {exam} Preparation

Many examinees fail not because of lack of effort, but due to inefficient study habits. Avoid these top mistakes to maximize your chance of success.

1. Cramming at the Last Minute

Spaced repetition and consistent daily practice are proven to be much more effective than marathon cramming sessions before the exam date.

2. Ignoring Timed Practice

Knowledge alone is not enough if you run out of time during the actual test. Practice under realistic time limits.
